name: STAR Units — sexagesimal angles
summary: Degrees to and from degrees/minutes/seconds and hours/minutes/seconds with one rounding on the whole angle; rounded fields identical to ERFA on 1200 of 1200 cases, joined angles within 1.2e-13 deg of ERFA and astropy, and out-of-range input refused.
reference: IAU 1976 obliquity: 23 deg 26' 21.448" = 23.4392911 deg (Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, ch. 22)
